query: What is the fee refund policy after admission cancellation?
ground_truth_answer: As per UGC and Central University of Kashmir guidelines, admission cancellation requests received prior to the formal closure of admissions are entitled to a refund with a nominal deduction (typically Rs 1,000 as processing fee). Cancellations submitted after closure are subject to graded deductions or forfeiture based on the timeline of withdrawal.

query: What is the minimum eligibility percentage for CUET PG admission in M.Sc Biotechnology?
ground_truth_answer: Candidates must have a Bachelor's degree in Biological Sciences, Biotechnology, or allied disciplines with at least 50% marks (or 45% for reserved category SC/ST/OBC/PwD candidates) and a valid CUET PG score.

query: What is the intake capacity and seat matrix for B.Tech Computer Science and Engineering?
ground_truth_answer: The Department of Information Technology at Central University of Kashmir has an annual intake capacity of 40 to 50 seats for B.Tech CSE, distributed across Open Merit, OBC-NCL, SC, ST, and EWS categories as per Government of India reservation rules.

query: What is the reservation percentage for SC, ST, OBC-NCL and EWS in admissions?
ground_truth_answer: Central University of Kashmir strictly implements Government of India reservation quotas: 15% for Scheduled Castes (SC), 7.5% for Scheduled Tribes (ST), 27% for Other Backward Classes (OBC Non-Creamy Layer), 10% for Economically Weaker Sections (EWS), and 5% horizontal reservation for Persons with Disabilities (PwD).

query: What are the lateral entry eligibility criteria for B.Tech CSE 3rd semester?
ground_truth_answer: Lateral entry admission to the 3rd semester of B.Tech CSE requires a 3-year Diploma in Computer Science/Engineering/IT with at least 50% marks (45% for reserved categories), or a B.Sc degree with Mathematics with at least 50% marks, subject to university lateral entry test merit.

query: Which documents are required for physical document verification during admission counseling?
ground_truth_answer: Required documents include CUET scorecard, 10th and 12th marks certificates, graduation marksheets (for PG programs), category certificate (SC/ST/OBC-NCL/EWS/PwD), domicile certificate, migration/character certificate, and passport photographs.

query: What is the eligibility requirement for the 5-year integrated BA LLB program?
ground_truth_answer: Candidates must have passed 10+2 (Higher Secondary Part II) or equivalent examination from a recognized board with at least 45% marks for General category and 40% marks for SC/ST categories, along with a valid CUET score.

query: How are spot admissions and mop-up counseling rounds conducted for vacant seats?
ground_truth_answer: Following regular counseling rounds, the university issues a spot admission notice for leftover vacant seats. Eligible registered CUET candidates must report in person or submit online confirmation to prepare a spot merit list.

query: What is the selection process and qualifying cutoff for MBA admission at CUK?
ground_truth_answer: MBA admission is based on the composite score of CUET PG (or CMAT) followed by Group Discussion and Personal Interview (GD/PI), with Bachelor's degree eligibility of at least 50% marks (45% for SC/ST).

query: What is the eligibility for Ph.D. admission and exemption from the entrance test?
ground_truth_answer: Candidates with a Master's degree (at least 55% marks or 50% for SC/ST/OBC) are eligible. Candidates who have qualified UGC-NET/CSIR-NET with JRF or equivalent national fellowship are exempt from the written entrance exam and appear directly for the interview.

query: What is the procedure for paying the admission fee through the Samarth portal?
ground_truth_answer: Selected candidates must log in to the CUK Samarth admission portal (cukashmiradmission.samarth.edu.in) using their CUET application credentials and complete the online fee payment before the declared deadline.

query: What is the Choice Based Credit System (CBCS) 10-point grading scale used by CUK?
ground_truth_answer: CUK follows the UGC 10-point CBCS grading system: O (Outstanding, 10), A+ (Excellent, 9), A (Very Good, 8), B+ (Good, 7), B (Above Average, 6), C (Average, 5), P (Pass, 4), and F (Fail, 0).

query: What is the weightage distribution between CIA and End Semester Examination?
ground_truth_answer: Evaluation consists of Continuous Internal Assessment (CIA) carrying 40% weightage (tests, assignments, presentations) and End Semester Examination (ESE) carrying 60% weightage of the total course marks.

query: What are the minimum passing marks required in Continuous Internal Assessment and End Semester theory?
ground_truth_answer: Students must secure at least 40% marks in the Continuous Internal Assessment (CIA) and at least 40% marks in the End Semester Examination separately to pass a course module.

query: What is the fee and procedure for re-evaluation of answer scripts after result declaration?
ground_truth_answer: Students dissatisfied with their results can apply for re-evaluation or scrutiny within 15 to 21 days of result notification by submitting the prescribed re-evaluation form along with the requisite fee per paper (typically Rs 500) to the Controller of Examinations.

query: What are the rules and supplementary examination fee for clearing backlog courses?
ground_truth_answer: Students who fail in any course can appear in supplementary/backlog examinations held alongside regular odd or even semester exams by paying the prescribed examination backlog fee per paper.

query: What is the maximum permissible duration (N+2 rule) to complete an academic program?
ground_truth_answer: Under the N+2 regulation, a student must complete the degree requirements within the standard duration of the program (N years) plus a maximum extension of 2 additional years, failing which registration lapses.

query: When are the Autumn session datesheets published for semester examinations?
ground_truth_answer: Examination datesheets for Autumn session end-semester exams are notified by the Controller of Examinations approximately 2 to 3 weeks before the commencement of exams on the university website.

query: How can students download their admit card or hall ticket for end-semester exams?
ground_truth_answer: Students must log in to the student examination portal using their enrollment number to verify cleared dues and download the hall ticket / admit card signed by the university.

query: What penalties does the Unfair Means Committee (UMC) impose for exam malpractice?
ground_truth_answer: The Unfair Means Committee investigates charges of malpractice during exams and may impose penalties ranging from cancellation of that specific paper to debarment from university examinations for one or more academic sessions.

query: What is the application process for obtaining an official university transcript?
ground_truth_answer: To obtain an official academic transcript, students must submit a formal application along with copies of all semester marksheets and proof of transcript fee payment to the Office of the Controller of Examinations.

query: What is the minimum attendance requirement to appear in End Semester Examinations?
ground_truth_answer: A minimum of 75% attendance in theory and practical classes is mandatory to be eligible to appear in End Semester Examinations. A condonation of up to 10% may be granted by the Vice Chancellor on documented medical or compassionate grounds.

query: Where is the Office of the Vice Chancellor located and what is the contact email?
ground_truth_answer: The Office of the Vice Chancellor is situated at the Main Campus, Tulmulla, Ganderbal, Jammu and Kashmir - 191201, with official correspondence routed through vc@cukashmir.ac.in.

query: Who is the Registrar of Central University of Kashmir and how to contact the administration?
ground_truth_answer: The Registrar heads the administrative machinery of Central University of Kashmir, stationed at the Main Campus Tulmulla, with official communication handled via registrar@cukashmir.ac.in.

query: What are the responsibilities and contact info of the Controller of Examinations?
ground_truth_answer: The Controller of Examinations (COE) oversees examination conduct, evaluation, result notifications, and issuance of degrees/transcripts, reachable via coe@cukashmir.ac.in.

query: Who heads the Proctorial Board and what is the university proctor contact for discipline?
ground_truth_answer: The Proctorial Board is headed by the Chief Proctor, responsible for maintaining campus discipline, security, and student grievance resolution across campuses.

query: What is the function of the Dean Academic Affairs (DAA) office at CUK?
ground_truth_answer: The Dean Academic Affairs coordinates academic programs, curricula design, academic council affairs, and notifications regarding the university academic calendar.

query: What facilities and programs are managed by the Dean Students Welfare (DSW)?
ground_truth_answer: The DSW office organizes co-curricular activities, cultural festivals, student clubs, youth leadership programs, and provides student counseling and welfare support.

query: How can a student file a complaint with the Internal Complaints Committee (ICC)?
ground_truth_answer: Under POSH regulations, any aggrieved student or employee can submit a formal written complaint regarding sexual harassment to the Presiding Officer of the Internal Complaints Committee (ICC) within 3 months of the incident.

query: What are the anti-ragging measures and 24x7 helpline contacts for CUK students?
ground_truth_answer: CUK enforces a zero-tolerance policy against ragging with active Anti-Ragging squads. Incidents can be reported to the Chief Proctor or the National Anti-Ragging Toll-Free Helpline at 1800-180-5522.

query: How to contact the Finance Officer regarding tuition fee slips and challans?
ground_truth_answer: The Finance Officer manages financial administration and student fee accounts. Students can contact the Finance Branch at the Main Campus Tulmulla for fee receipts and clearance issues.

query: What services does the Equal Opportunity Cell provide for PwD and minority students?
ground_truth_answer: The Equal Opportunity Cell (EOC) facilitates barrier-free campus accessibility, assistive learning technology, coaching schemes, and specialized support for students with disabilities and marginalized backgrounds.

query: What healthcare facilities and ambulance service are available at Tulmulla campus?
ground_truth_answer: The university operates a Health Centre at the Tulmulla campus staffed with medical officers and nursing staff, equipped with first aid, essential medications, and emergency ambulance transport.

query: What are the core subjects in B.Tech Computer Science and Engineering semester 3?
ground_truth_answer: Core subjects in B.Tech CSE Semester 3 include Data Structures and Algorithms, Discrete Mathematics, Object-Oriented Programming with C++/Java, Computer Organization, and Digital Electronics.

query: What is the course structure and elective options for the Master of Computer Applications (MCA)?
ground_truth_answer: The 2-year MCA curriculum encompasses advanced courses in Database Systems, Operating Systems, Web Technologies, Software Engineering, Machine Learning, Cloud Computing, and a final semester major industrial project.

query: What courses are taught in M.Sc Mathematics first semester?
ground_truth_answer: M.Sc Mathematics Semester 1 covers fundamental subjects including Real Analysis, Advanced Abstract Algebra, Ordinary Differential Equations, and Topology.

query: What are the practical and broadcast modules in M.A. Convergent Journalism?
ground_truth_answer: The M.A. Convergent Journalism program combines Print Journalism, Broadcast Radio/TV production, Online/Multi-platform reporting, Media Law and Ethics, and hands-on digital newsroom studio exercises.

query: What are the moot court and clinical legal education requirements in BA LLB?
ground_truth_answer: The 5-year integrated BA LLB program mandates clinical legal courses including Moot Court exercises, Mock Trial advocacy, Legal Aid clinic duties, and compulsory annual internships with law firms or courts.

query: What subjects are included in the M.Sc Biotechnology curriculum?
ground_truth_answer: The M.Sc Biotechnology syllabus covers Molecular Biology, Cell Biology, Genetic Engineering, Immunology, Bioinformatics, Bioprocess Engineering, and research dissertation work.

query: What dual specializations are offered in the MBA program at Central University of Kashmir?
ground_truth_answer: CUK MBA offers dual specializations across Marketing Management, Financial Management, Human Resource Management, and Operations & Information Systems.

query: What areas of literature are studied in the M.A. English curriculum?
ground_truth_answer: M.A. English covers British Poetry and Drama, American Literature, Indian Writing in English, Postcolonial Studies, Literary Criticism and Contemporary Cultural Theory.

query: What core physics subjects are covered in M.Sc Physics at CUK?
ground_truth_answer: Core subjects in M.Sc Physics include Classical Mechanics, Quantum Mechanics, Mathematical Physics, Electrodynamics, Statistical Mechanics, and Condensed Matter Physics.

query: What are the research dissertation and pedagogical modules in M.Ed?
ground_truth_answer: The M.Ed curriculum features Philosophy of Education, Advanced Educational Psychology, Research Methodology, Educational Technology, Field Internship, and a mandatory research dissertation.

query: What modules and lab practicals are included in M.Sc Zoology?
ground_truth_answer: The M.Sc Zoology program covers Animal Diversity and Taxonomy, Comparative Anatomy, Animal Physiology, Genetics and Evolution, Parasitology, Fisheries, and comprehensive laboratory practicals.

query: What is the hostel allocation policy and who gets priority for hostel admission?
ground_truth_answer: Hostel seats are allocated based on academic entrance merit and geographic distance from the university, with priority accorded to outstation students, female candidates, and persons with disabilities.

query: What are the hostel mess charges and dining hall rules at CUK?
ground_truth_answer: Hostel mess functions on a cooperative or managed basis where residents pay a monthly mess charge based on actual food expenditure, plus a one-time refundable mess security deposit.

query: What amenities are available in university hostels at Tulmulla campus?
ground_truth_answer: Hostels at Tulmulla provide furnished rooms, high-speed Wi-Fi, 24/7 power backup with inverters/generators, hot water during winter, reading rooms, common recreational areas, and round-the-clock security.

query: What university bus routes and transport facilities operate to Tulmulla campus?
ground_truth_answer: The university operates dedicated buses connecting Srinagar city center (Lal Chowk, Pantha Chowk, Bemina) and major district towns to the Tulmulla and Nunar campuses for nominal monthly transport fares.

query: How are semester tuition fees paid and what are the penalties for late fee payment?
ground_truth_answer: Semester fees must be paid online via the Samarth student portal or SBI Collect. Failure to pay within the stipulated window attracts progressive late fine penalties as notified by the administration.

query: What means-cum-merit financial aid is available for economically weaker students?
ground_truth_answer: CUK offers financial assistance and fee concessions through its Students Welfare Fund and Means-cum-Merit scholarship scheme for students whose family annual income falls below designated thresholds.

query: Which National Scholarship Portal (NSP) schemes can CUK students apply for?
ground_truth_answer: Eligible students can apply for Central Sector Scheme of Scholarships, Post-Matric Scholarships for SC/ST/OBC students, and Merit-cum-Means Scholarships for Minorities through the NSP portal.

query: What are the central library timings, borrowing limits, and digital subscriptions?
ground_truth_answer: The University Central Library opens on all working days from 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM, providing textbook borrowing, a Book Bank facility, and access to e-journals through UGC-eShodhSindhu and DELNET.

query: What sports and gymnasium facilities are available for students at CUK?
ground_truth_answer: The Directorate of Physical Education & Sports provides indoor badminton, table tennis, a modern gymnasium, and outdoor grounds for cricket, football, and volleyball, organizing annual intra-university tourneys.

query: What is the procedure for obtaining caution money refund after graduation?
ground_truth_answer: Graduating students must obtain a 'No Dues Certificate' signed by the Department, Central Library, Hostel Provost, and Sports Office before submitting a caution money refund form to the Finance Branch.

query: Where are the campus cafeterias located and what are their hygiene guidelines?
ground_truth_answer: University cafeterias operate at Tulmulla and Nunar campuses providing meals, snacks, and beverages at subsidized rates monitored for hygiene by the university Canteen Management Committee.
